// diagnostic

E1205

The lock file `{path}` is corrupt.

What

The lock file `{path}` is corrupt.

Why

Jet found malformed lock data or a value larger than the 1 MiB safety limit, so it stopped before using the lock. The lock file is regenerable.

Fix

Delete `{path}` and rerun the command to regenerate it.
